correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the all-vertices rooted tree distance classes, sibling, interbranch S and radial P blocks and their exact dimensions. The identity P/m-S=m times a positive Laplace Gram matrix for 1<p<2 forces the radial sector to cross first. The determinant equation a_m c_m,l = l b_m^2 has a unique root in (1,log2(2m/(m-1))); one radial nullity gives endpoint rank. Independent bracketing numerics give p2,2≈1.5271730883 and p3,3≈1.2973684654, correcting potentially spurious unrestricted determinant roots. Analytic expansion of determinant near p=1 gives b²(p_b,b−1)→1/log(32/27).
